messages:
Priya K: Quick sync — followup from the Thursday incident. We promised adding a few test/eval lanes and I want to lock owners + timelines. High-level asks: regression prompt set, nightly load tests, a small chaos drill, and a couple of targeted evals for the new KV cache changes.
Julian M: I can take the regression prompt set and the targeted evals for KV cache. Plan: assemble failing+golden prompts, add ~50 new edge-case prompts, run locally then in CI. ETA draft by next Wed. :handshake: 
Sam R: I'll own the nightly load tests and the chaos drill. For load: add a 1hr 200rps job against staging + a 30m sustained spike. For chaos: simulate GPU eviction + transient redis errors. Need infra help for isolated pool.
Taylor P: Thanks — do we have a single tracker for these items? Product wants expected dates for customers impacted. Also need clarity on acceptance criteria for "pass" vs "needs investigation" on the evals.
Priya K: I'll create a followup board card and map out acceptance criteria. Quick proposal: regression pass = no >2% drop in top-line metrics across prompt set; KV evals: token-level perplexity + endpoint latency thresholds. I'll post specifics to the board and ping owners.
ops-bot: Created issue INF-2743 "Post-incident: testing roadmap (regression/load/chaos)" and added Priya K, Julian M, Sam R as assignees. Link: https://redwood.internal/INF-2743
Julian M: For the regression prompt set, question: do we keep the current tokenization and sampling config or test multiple decoding configs? My suggestion: baseline with prod config, plus a quick sweep of top-k/top-p variations (k=50,p=0.9) to catch decoding-sensitive regressions.
Sam R: Agree baseline with prod config. For chaos drill, can we schedule the GPU eviction test during the lower traffic window on Thurs 03:00 PST? We'll coordinate with eng-sre. Also need a rollback plan for any stuck kv-cache entries.
Priya K: Thursday 03:00 PST sounds good. I'll block the time and add eng-sre as observers. For rollback — ops runbook will include kv-cache flush + autoscaler override steps. I'll draft the snippet here:
```
# emergency kv-cache flush
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/kv/flush -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
# scale override
redwood scale workforce --pool=test-pool --replicas 0; wait 60s; redwood scale workforce --pool=test-pool --replicas 3
```
Taylor P: Nice. Can we get a short summary for customers after the tests? One paragraph on what we tested and whether there's any service changes. I'll draft the comms but need the final results by Friday EOD.
Priya K: Will do. Owners: Julian = regression + KV evals (draft Wed), Sam = load + chaos (test Thu 03:00 PST), Priya = tracking, runbook, comms. Ops-bot created INF-2743 so we'll use that as the single source. I'll update acceptance criteria on the card by EOD today.
Julian M: Quick note — we should include one adversarial prompt bucket derived from the incident logs (the series of prompts that triggered tokenization edge case). I'll pull samples and add to the prompt set.
Sam R: Also adding a telemetry check in the load job to detect sudden token-rate spikes — last incident showed transient token churn.
Taylor P: Sounds like a plan. If you need product help prioritizing prompts, ping me.
Priya K: Thx all — I'll follow up in INF-2743 and post a short summary here when the card has acceptance criteria. :white_check_mark:
